integrity: Exact probabilistic proof, complete finite verification code, and explicit separation of foundational prior methods; no claim of independent mathematical audit or peer-reviewed publication.
scientific_limitations: Uniform ordinary two-copy Stirling permutations only; one explicit mixed moment and sign, not full joint distribution or multi-copy extension. Prior joint generating functions can implicitly encode mixed moments, so historical priority is uncertain.
